title: Israel kills 3 in Gaza, including a child, as West Bank operation displaces 3,171 people in Hebron
detail: Israeli strikes killed three people in Gaza, including a child, while the Israeli operation in Al-Khalil (Hebron) in the occupied West Bank has displaced 3,171 people, according to a news report.

title: UN human rights chief warns of "ethnic cleansing" in Hebron
detail: The UN human rights chief warned of "ethnic cleansing" in Hebron (Al-Khalil), where the ongoing Israeli operation has displaced thousands of Palestinians, according to Middle East Eye live coverage. Details of the statement are limited to the live-blog headline.

media.caption: UN human rights chief warns of "ethnic cleansing" in Hebron
